import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr = df[numerical_cols].corr()

sns.heatmap(corr, annot=True, fmt=".2f", cmap='coolwarm', square=True, cbar_kws={"shrink": .8})
plt.title('Correlation Heatmap of Sleep Health Metrics')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
